### AI industry growth remains strong, but the pace is slowing
- Canonical URL: https://ainewsradar.xyz/news/a4b4c647fe434703
- Primary Source: THE DECODER (https://the-decoder.com/ai-industry-growth-remains-strong-but-the-pace-is-slowing/)
- Executive Summary: Ramp AI Index and OpenRouter data indicate that US corporate AI usage is hitting record highs while the average cost per million tokens has dropped below $0.45 due to aggressive pricing competition. Anthropic has surpassed OpenAI in both spending and volume market share, signaling a paradigm shift in the AI infrastructure market from a high-premium phase to a defensive pricing cycle.
- Key Verified Facts:
* [Core Event] Ramp, Anthropic, OpenAI (US enterprise AI API market): Token unit prices fell 21.2% in six weeks; total expenditure declined from peak despite rising volumes.
* [Root Cause & Mechanism] Aggressive market share competition among model providers is decoupling inference demand from revenue growth.
* [Key Metrics] Token unit price dropped 21.2% in six weeks to an average of $0.45 per million tokens.
* [Key Position & Outlook] The widening gap between inference volume and revenue indicates an entry into a defensive pricing cycle.
